basic_info.description: Experience modern urban living in this rarely available Yerba Buena Loft, part of Stanley Saitowitz's iconic architectural masterpiece. This dramatic residence showcases soaring 16-foot ceilings, exposed concrete walls, warm bamboo flooring, and a sleek kitchen with stainless steel appliances.        Commuting is effortless with close proximity to 280, 101, BART, Muni, Caltrain, and the new Yerba Buena/Moscone Central Subway station.    Additional highlights include in-unit washer/dryer, 24-hour security, and the convenience of deeded parking.
